## BMW M 1000 RS Engine and Performance: 218hp from a 999cc Inline-Four

The BMW M 1000 RS is powered by the familiar 999cc, four-cylinder engine that also powers the M 1000 R and M 1000 RR. However, in the RS version, this engine has been tuned for higher performance output. [...] Currently, there has been no official announcement regarding an India launch. It would also be inaccurate to consider German pricing as the direct Indian expected price, as final pricing may vary depending on taxes, import duties, and local market strategy.

## Auto India Daily Verdict

The BMW M 1000 RS isn’t just a cosmetic upgrade. Compared to the standard M 1000 R, higher power output, carbon winglets, M Carbon wheels, and electronically controlled suspension make it a more focused performance package. [...] 218 hp and a claimed top speed of 283 kph place it in the serious performance motorcycle category. But the 1,000-unit production limit and 40,000-euro price make it an exclusive BMW M model rather than a mass-market offering. The biggest question for Indian enthusiasts now is whether BMW will officially introduce it in India.
